articles.summary: Public-Private Partnership with EsSalud Enters Investment and Construction Phase Auna S.A. (“Auna” or the “Company”), a leading healthcare services platform in Latin America with operations in Mexico, Peru and Colombia, today announced the fulfillment of all conditions precedent to the commencement of construction under its Public-Private Partnership (“PPP”) agreement with EsSalud, Peru’s Social Health Insurance agency. Following formal confirmation from EsSalud, the Centro Ambulatorio Trecca project will enter its investment and construction phase, representing a significant execution milestone for Auna and a substantial increase in its addressable market in Peru. Expanding Auna’s Addressable Market The PPP provides Auna with access to a new and largely untapped segment of Peru’s healthcare market: the large EsSalud-insured population comprising approximately six million residents of Lima. This substantially expands Auna’s addressable market beyond its current patient and payor base
articles.title: Auna Announces Fulfillment of All Conditions Precedent for Construction of Centro Ambulatorio Trecca in Lima

articles.summary: Company Will Host Investor Day Today Auna S.A. (“Auna” or the “Company”) (NYSE: AUNA), a Latin American healthcare company with operations in Mexico, Peru and Colombia, announced today a preliminary update to its full-year 2026 outlook. Consistent with the recently disclosed operating KPIs that reflect favorable volume and specialty service trends in the third-quarter of 2026, the Company expects full-year 2026 revenue growth to be in line with the guidance communicated early in the year. The revenue guidance is supported by a continued strong recovery in Mexico during the second half of the year. During its second-quarter 2026 earnings call, the Company indicated that, excluding one-time effects primarily related to payor billing penalties associated with reconciliations of prior years’ receivables, full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA growth was expected to be at the lower end of its previously announced guidance range of 10% to 14% FX-neutral.
